composition_subtypes.role: Sort cowbell sizes to enable greedy pairing
Two-pointer greedy to pair smallest with largest in subset

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort array, then use two-pointer greedy to pair smallest with largest from a selected subset to minimize maximum box sum.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts the cowbell sizes, then uses a greedy two-pointer approach that pairs the smallest and largest among the items that are not packed singly, updating the maximum. This combines sorting and greedy algorithms.
